linkedin.text:
A gala dinner in a hotel ballroom is forgotten by March. A dinner two streets from the Pantheon is not.

This is Rome at night, on a programme we produced in Italy. The city does something no venue budget can buy: it puts your company inside a place people already consider important.

Rome is not the easy option. Coach access in the centro storico is restricted, the best rooms book eleven months out, and August is a mistake. But for a board-level gathering, an anniversary, or a client-facing event where the setting is part of the message, few cities compete.

We have produced across 130+ destinations. Rome stays on the list because it changes how a group behaves once they are in it.

Considering Italy for 2026? Tell us the guest list and we'll tell you honestly whether Rome is right.

Uproduction Events — From Business to Pleasure

📩 alon@upe.co.il
